中文

体验优化
- 适配 **DSH desktop 0.2.2-rc.1**:宿主与 Web Client 契约逐项核对无破坏(宿主 13 项 / 客户端 11 项),并在隔离的 0.2.2-rc.1 profile 里冷启动验证 —— 插件行正常挂载、`/remote-tunnel/*` 路由经 `ctx.connection.admit()` 应答、客户端 bundle 出现在 `__DSH_BOOT__` 并被正确投递
- DSH peer 范围显式补上 0.2.2 预发布线(`... || ^0.2.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.2-rc.1`),普通 SemVer 的 peer 检查(pnpm、registry 工具)与桌面端 `includePrerelease` 规则保持一致
- **远端 Node 下限提到 24.9**(跟随 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2` 的 `engines.node`):`bootstrap` 需要时会用 NodeSource 装 Node 24,`check` 报 `node >= 24.9`,CLI 帮助与中英 README 同步;Node 22.19–24.8 的远端账号现在会明确报错,而不是装上一个 engine 不满足的 dsh

问题修复
- peer 范围显式包含 0.2.1 预发布线,普通 SemVer 检查也能接受 DSH 0.2.1 预发布版(该修复此前在 Unreleased,本版一并发布)

---

English

Improvements
- Support **DSH desktop 0.2.2-rc.1**: every host-plane and web-client contract was re-verified (13 host / 11 client coupling points, no breaks), plus an isolated 0.2.2-rc.1 profile cold-boot where the plugin row mounts, `/remote-tunnel/*` answers through `ctx.connection.admit()`, and the client bundle is advertised in `__DSH_BOOT__` and served
- The DSH peer range names the 0.2.2 prerelease line explicitly (`... || ^0.2.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.2-rc.1`), so plain SemVer peer checks (pnpm, registry tooling) agree with the desktop runtime's `includePrerelease` rule
- **The remote Node floor is now 24.9**, tracking `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2`'s `engines.node`: `bootstrap` installs Node 24 via NodeSource when needed, `check` reports `node >= 24.9`, and the CLI help plus both READMEs follow; a remote account on Node 22.19–24.8 now fails explicitly instead of installing a dsh whose engine it misses

Bug Fixes
- The peer range names the 0.2.1 prerelease line explicitly, so plain SemVer checks accept DSH 0.2.1 prereleases too (the fix previously sat under Unreleased and ships with this release)
